messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points that maximizes the minimum area over all 286 triangles is the affine image of a regular 13-gon inscribed in the unit square, achieved by placing vertices at parametric positions (1/2 + r cos θ_i, 1/2 + r sin θ_i) where θ_i = 2πi/13 and r is chosen so the polygon is tangent to all four sides of the square. The minimum triangle area is attained by three consecutive vertices and equals (1/4)sin(2π/13)/(1 + cos(π/13))^2 ≈ 0.01096, and no other arrangement of 13 points in the unit square can achieve a larger minimum triangle area."}
